sensor: Un-cooled vanadium oxide (VOx) microbolometer FPA, 17 um pixel pitch
features: Thermal imaging, VGA 640 x 480 at 9 fps (<9 Hz version)
Integrated Intelligent Video Analytics (line crossing, loitering, counting, ship tracking)
Detection range 315 m (human) / 1450 m (object) with 16.7 mm lens
Hybrid operation with surge-protected analog CVBS (NTSC) output
Audio line in/out (2 x 3.5 mm jacks), full/half duplex
2 alarm inputs, 1 alarm output, RS-232/422/485 data port
IP66 / NEMA-4X, wind load 150 mph, salt mist tested
ONVIF Profile S, G and M
dimensions_mm: 141 x 164 x 430 (H x W x L, incl. sunshield)
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (DINION_IP_thermal_80_Data_sheet_enUS_23112691083.pdf). VS suffix = <9 Hz (9 fps) VGA export-friendly version (VF = 30 fps). Weight stated as <3.5 kg. ndaa_compliant set because the datasheet ordering entry states 'NDAA compliant' for this SKU. Datasheet V5, May 2022.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.
